meta.note: Council finance rules for Welsh councils, beside data/config/rules.json (England) and rules_scotland.json. The engine reads these; nothing in code restates them. Each rule cites the law that sets it.

sources.title: Local Government Finance Act 1992, section 5: different amounts for dwellings in different valuation bands (subsection 1A: Wales, nine bands)
The Council Tax (Valuation Bands) (Wales) Order 2003 (SI 2003/3046 (W.291)): bands A to I from 1 April 2005
The Council Tax (Discounts, Disregards and Exemptions) (Wales) Regulations 2026 (W.S.I. 2026/8), regulation 3: the 25% discount (under section 11E of the 1992 Act)
Local Government Finance Act 1992, section 32: calculation of budget requirement (Wales)
Local Government Finance Act 1988, section 114: functions of responsible officer as regards reports
Local Government Finance Act 1992, Chapter 4A (sections 52A to 52Y): limitation of council tax and precepts in Wales (capping by the Welsh Ministers)
The Council Tax (Administration and Enforcement) Regulations 1992, Schedule 1: payments (ten instalments, twelve on request, in England and Wales)

band_ratios.note: Band I (above £424,000 in 2003 values) added by SI 2003/3046 from April 2005.

single_person_discount.note: From 1 April 2026 under section 11E; section 11 before.

balanced_budget.tolerance_note: £5,000. StatsWales gives the budget to the £10, so sums of rounded lines can differ by a little. Anything larger is shown as still to find or spare, never rounded to balanced.

2026-27.applies_to: Welsh councils: no referendums; the Welsh Ministers can cap a rise instead

instalments.note: Ten by default; twelve on request (in Wales from 1 April 2013).
